metadata.explanation: Task requires cloning a git repository. Evaluator checks the git remote URL to verify the correct repository was cloned.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking git remote URL using 'git remote get-url origin' command. Expected URL contains 'anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if remote URL contains expected repository path, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts git remote URL from the expected repository path using 'git remote get-url origin'
Metric logic correctly checks if the remote URL contains the expected substring 'anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python'
Expected value handling is correct - uses 'expected.get('url', '')' which properly accesses the rules dict when type='rule'
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the core requirement that the correct repository was cloned to the correct location
Substring matching approach is flexible and works with different URL formats (https, git@, .git suffix, etc.)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts URL string -> metric receives and compares -> returns binary score
